extracted.name: Air Fryer Meatballs
extracted.description: These easy Air Fryer Meatballs are perfectly crisp on the outside, tender on the inside, and only take a few minutes to make.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound lean ground beef or ground turkey
instruction_lines: Mix Meatball Ingredients: In a large bowl combine all ingredients except for the meat. Stir and rest for 10 minutes so the crackers can soak up the liquid. Add the meat and mix just until combined (don’t over mix).
Form 15 meatballs about the size of golf balls, and gently sprinkle them all around with flour. Preheat air fryer to 400.
Air Fry: Spray the basket with cooking spray, add meatballs in one layer leaving a little space between each. Air fry for 9-11 minutes or until cooked through. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Store leftover meatballs in the fridge for up to 5 days.
categories: How long to cook raw meatballs in air fryer
